label: Evening together
description: She books the evening in her quarters. AUTHOR TO WRITE: the long text.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: This evening is mine. My quarters. Do not be late. — {name}

label: Training together
description: She books the afternoon in the training yard. AUTHOR TO WRITE: the long text.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Afternoon, the yard. Bring something to prove. — {name}

label: A walk on the roof
description: She books the evening on the roof. AUTHOR TO WRITE: the long text.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The roof, this evening. Just the two of us. — {name}

label: Held in her quarters
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a practice keeps the commander in her quarters; the calendar shows it.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Stay where you are. — {name}

label: Her exam
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a drill holder books the weekly exam at the training yard: she runs each of her norms and judges the sum.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: The exam is on. The yard, on the hour. — {name}

label: Her drill session
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: after a failed exam she books extra drills at the training yard.
text: AUTHOR TO WRITE: Not good enough. Extra drill, the yard. — {name}
